featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Surendran
featured_reviews.review_text:
From my recent interaction with Darshan Electronics Sales and Services in IC Colony, Borivali west, I can confidently affirm that it is the go-to shop for all your electronics needs. My requirement was a bit peculiar - I needed a window AC on rent for just three months. Not only did they have the item I needed, but the whole process from the selection of the AC to its installation and final return was streamlined and efficient.

The service offered by Darshan Electronics Sales and Services goes beyond the usual customer experience. The key highlight of my experience was interacting with Mr. Hasmukhji, who oversees the operations. Hasmukhji was more than just a salesman or a service provider; he was genuinely invested in ensuring that my needs were met. Always reachable either on call or in person, Hasmukhji exuded an aura of authenticity and dedication that is often hard to find in today's fast-paced world.

Apart from his affable personality, what set Hasmukhji apart was his professionalism. There was no unnecessary delay or roundabout talks; his approach was straightforward and to the point. His promptness extended to financial dealings as well. I never had to follow up for my deposit; the money was transferred back to my account even before the AC was loaded back into his vehicle at the end of the rental period.

Furthermore, I was particularly impressed by the condition of the window AC I rented. Despite being a hard-to-find model, it was well-maintained and functioned impeccably throughout the rental period.

I will certainly reach out to them for any of my future electronics needs and would highly recommend them to anyone in need of electronic products or services. An exceptional experience all around!

featured_reviews.review_text: DiMart is one of the best go-to spot for budget shopping, especially if you're looking for inexpensive clothing. Their selection of groceries and household items is also affordable, though not as cheap as their clothing range. However, be prepared for chaos during holidays—it gets incredibly crowded. The customer service leaves much to be desired; staff often seem clueless about where to find items, which can make shopping frustrating. If you're after deals and can overlook the service and crowds, it's worth a visit for the savings.

featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to shop for all your grocery and toiletries needs because of the great discounts. D Mart caters to all household requirements from A to Z! This place gets overcrowded though with entire families coming for all their shopping needs. The best time to enjoy a relaxed shopping experience is 9 to 11 in the mornings and 2 to 5 in the afternoons. It is a store of ground plus two floors so do visit with your walking shoes on 😄

featured_reviews.review_text:

Weekends can be crowded, so best to visit on weekdays or early mornings. Billing counters are efficient but expect queues during peak hours. Parking is available but gets full fast.

The store is clean, air-conditioned, and regularly restocked. Staff is helpful if you ask. No public washroom inside, though.

Great spot for budget shopping in Dahisar West.
